findings.title: Total Joint Arthroplasty (L40232)
findings.quote: Primary total knee arthroplasty is considered reasonable and medically necessary if all of the following criteria have been met: Advanced joint disease; Moderate to severe pain and loss of function using standardized pain and function scales for assessment; Radiographic findings demonstrating advanced arthritic changes; A trial of at least 1 or more conservative therapy without improvement in pain and function typically for a duration of a minimum of 3 months; Optimization of co-morbidities if applicable.
findings.note: New CGS LCD 'Total Joint Arthroplasty' L40232 for J15 (KY/OH), eff 03/15/2026 (finalized from proposed DL40232); covers TKA and THA (verified in CMS MCD).

findings.title: Total Joint Arthroplasty (L40232)
findings.quote: Primary total knee arthroplasty is considered reasonable and medically necessary if all of the following criteria have been met: Advanced joint disease; Moderate to severe pain and loss of function using standardized pain and function scales for assessment; Radiographic findings demonstrating advanced arthritic changes; A trial of at least 1 or more conservative therapy without improvement in pain and function typically for a duration of a minimum of 3 months; Optimization of co-morbidities if applicable.
findings.note: New CGS LCD 'Total Joint Arthroplasty' L40232 for J15 (KY/OH), eff 03/15/2026 (finalized from proposed DL40232); covers TKA and THA (verified in CMS MCD). Parallel criteria stated for primary total hip arthroplasty.

findings.title: Major Joint Replacement (Hip and Knee) (L33618)
findings.quote: Advanced joint disease demonstrated by radiographic supported evidence or MRI supported evidence (subchondral cysts, subchondral sclerosis, periarticular osteophytes, joint subluxation, joint space narrowing, avascular necrosis); and pain or functional disability from injury due to trauma or arthritis of the joint; and unsuccessful history of appropriate conservative therapy.
findings.note: First Coast LCD 'Major Joint Replacement (Hip and Knee)' L33618 for JN (FL/PR/USVI); currently in effect, revision eff 01/08/2019; covers TKA and THA (verified in CMS MCD).
